|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Xizor's Bounty (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V6-D-xizorsbounty-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-xizorsbounty022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/xizorsbounty.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual6-Dark/large/xizorsbounty.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). If character is about to leave table or be captured, peek at opponent's hand, retrieve 1 Force, and lose this Immediate Effect.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Xizor's Bounty (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 22 April 2024<ref name="img-xizorsbountyeb9f1e8">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/xizorsbounty.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb9f1e88dd679e4fa7860bc7cc8b6032d3476e13 commit eb9f1e8] (22 April 2024); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual6-Dark/large/xizorsbounty.gif (today's copy is the latest version only).
